design.estimand: population correlation after block adjustment and independent wafer measurement error

engine_integration.method: products.p3.engine.associate_quality; independent DGP, verified wafer-site context and complete-frame metadata

informative_cluster_size_and_missing_sit.lot_size_pattern: 10 positive lots have 3 wafers each; 10 negative lots have 1 each
informative_cluster_size_and_missing_sit.single_missing_site_reason: holdout wafers do not cover the selected map's exact observed-site mask

interpretation: Synthetic Monte Carlo only. The candidate averages wafer estimates within lot and uses lots as independent units; this does not establish manufacturing validity or complete control of within-lot dependence.

predeclared_acceptance.candidate: Average Fisher-z wafer correlations within each lot, then estimate across independent lots; no wafer pseudoreplication
predeclared_acceptance.informative_cluster_size: Unequal lot sizes correlated with lot effect preserve equal-lot estimand rather than wafer weighting; one missing site in any wafer abstains.
predeclared_acceptance.useful_gain: At least 5% reduction in median 95% interval width at unchanged independent lot count
